implementation_summary: Replaced the unconditional POSIX fcntl dependency with a host-selected fail-closed locking adapter: supported POSIX hosts retain flock shared/exclusive behavior, while native Windows uses a deterministic per-EXCHANGE Win32 named mutex with blocking acquisition and checked release/handle closure. Windows treats reads and writes as exclusive, preserving safety at the cost of harmlessly reduced reader concurrency. Archive preparation copies the already locked EXCHANGE content and avoids unsupported Windows directory-fsync behavior while retaining existing POSIX directory fsync. Added repository-controlled LF checkout policy, made canonical LF test fixtures explicit, made artifact traversal/inventory sorting depend on canonical relative POSIX strings, and added focused locking, failure, concurrency, and ordering coverage. No Markdown blob changed and no Governance, RCAB, Consumer, digest, byte-count, or package semantics were weakened.
